descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · TFA-92595 AC 1, AC 3, AC 6 · “Match the attached prototype design and functionality”.

Approach · TC-17 Post-Round Review & Completion · S22 Prototype parity (p72_HAIKU) and 'no EHR read or write anywhere' review

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T1 Post-Round matches the attached prototype (RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html) in design and functionality. (TFA-92595 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T2 Copy is clipboard only: no real EHR read or write happens anywhere. (TFA-92595 AC 3; TFA-92595 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T7 The Note tab shows tomorrow's Pre-Round summary underneath the note. (TFA-92595 How it works 3) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress
  • T3 The Billing Suggestion appears on the Note tab, alongside (below) the note. (TFA-92595 AC 6; TFA-92595 How it works 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92595 in progress

Test design technique: Happy path (happy-path) — Walk the normal flow exactly as the UAT / ticket words it; everything it names has to show up.

Given The prototype RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html attached to TFA-92595; the app at origin/main e02167f

When Compare Post-Round side by side in both contexts (Ask button, toggle bar, note card, Copy to EMR, Tomorrow's summary, billing card, Mark Encounter Complete, the Pending Tasks sheet); then review the code behind Copy to EMR, Copy A&P and Mark Encounter Complete for any EHR or other external call

Then Layout, labels and behaviour match the prototype in both contexts, including Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary under the note and the billing card below the note; Copy's only effects are a clipboard write and the in-app export record; no EHR endpoint, SDK or credential anywhere

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Human side-by-side and code review; each mismatch quoted with the screen or file/line. 'Underneath' (T7) and 'below the note' (T3) are judged here because the lane-A specs only check that the heading and the card are visible. The automated network evidence for the copy path is S02 a7 (Q10)

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method CODEREVIEW · Code review; lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-17.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the Allure status was changed by the triage from passed to broken.

Issue type: Ticket not ready for QA · environment local · tickets TFA-92595 ready for qa

Copying a Nursing Home note to EMR writes no in-app export record, while the Hospital copy does. The code also suggests the Nursing Home Post-Round lacks the prototype's Tomorrow's Pre-Round Summary and Pending Tasks sheet. There is no EHR call anywhere.

Evidence: Allure ab13d5d0, code-review failed. The NH PostRoundTab calls useCopyToEmr with no logExport callback. All of S22's requirements (T1/T2/T3/T7) are gated 'blocked: TFA-92595 in progress'. The missing NH export record is a new finding, not in the dev report or ledger. The layout half still needs a person's sign-off.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: CODEREVIEW · Code review; secondary: STATIC · Static check (build output / scan) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

Layout half is a human side-by-side; differences found in code vs p72 for the reviewer: (1) Hospital Note tab renders the Billing Suggestion card BELOW 'Mark Encounter Complete' (p72: billing under the note, the button last; How it works 6 'at the bottom'); NH order matches p72; (2) NH button 'Mark Visit Complete' vs p72 'Mark Encounter Complete'; (3) Hospital task rows keep the urgent flag (retired in p72) and list done tasks struck through instead of p72's 'Pending (n)' list; (4) p72 has no Copy A&P (AC 4 added later).

Evidence: 0 attached; 3 not attached:

  • apps/web/src/features/rounding/patient/PostRoundTab.tsx — not found (not written yet, or a wrong path)
  • apps/web/src/features/snf/patient/PostRoundTab.tsx — not found (not written yet, or a wrong path)
  • handoff-docs/RoundCompanion_PLAYGROUND_p72_HAIKU.html:8371-8920 — not found (not written yet, or a wrong path)

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: outside-runner (manual: doc-review). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):

  • [local code-review] failed · product (code-review/results.json) — code-review: failed → failed · product (failed · product (the lane wrote no productIssue; counted from its physicianImpact)) Neither context calls an EHR. Both Post-Round tabs send Copy to EMR through useCopyToEmr, and that calls only copyTextToClipboard: the Capacitor Clipboard on mobile, otherwise navigator.clipboard.writeText, with a hidden-textarea execCommand fallback.
